proposal.reason: Main change is to CI test orchestration and reporting: workflows now generate on-demand daily case inputs from JSON families, expand scheduling/grouping policy (including cross-rack/rack_nodes and 1/2/4/8-node selection), run updated cluster actions, and produce/upload a validated performance workbook artifact. Added/updated xtest generators, grouping, reconciliation/report logic, and tests are supporting CI execution infrastructure rather than runtime modules.
